name: Serendipaceratops
isnote: Described as a basal neoceratopsian, but the single ulna may belong to another ornithischian, possibly an ankylosaur (cited Wikipedia revision).
sum: Serendipaceratops is an Australian Early Cretaceous ornithischian known only from a single ulna, once interpreted as a ceratopsian.
wsnote: Based on one ulna 16 cm long; no body size given.
holotype: NMV P186385, a left ulna — Wonthaggi Formation, Victoria, Australia (early Aptian).
biology: Not inferable from a single bone.
author: Rich and Vickers-Rich 2003

sources.text: T. Rich and P. Vickers-Rich. 2003. Protoceratopsian? ulnae from Australia. Records of the Queen Victoria Museum Launceston 113:1-12
